theme: librarian sorts carousels that only rotate in linked groups
title: Reading-Hall Carousel Reshelving
strategies: identity replay baseline: assume each physical carousel already holds its own book range and just spin its shelf forward hoping to match (evaluator's internal weak reference; wastes a full revolution on every carousel that turns out to be the wrong one, then nudges the hall and retries)

structure-aware forward-only fix: read each book's stamped home carousel/shelf-slot off its id, align the hall to the home carousel of book 0, then spin every shelf home -- always spinning forward, never checking whether backward is shorter

Schreier-Sims stabilizer-chain solve: same id-based block discovery, but at every level (hall, then each shelf) pick whichever direction (forward/backward) is closer, so cost is the sum of per-level minimal distances -- additive per block level and never redone
held-out generalization on larger halls (more carousels and/or deeper shelves) to confirm the chain-based policy keeps its lead as N grows
